notes.author: FNOL-INTAKE
notes.note: First notice of loss: water damage - upstairs bathroom, claimed $8,500. Assigned to ADJ-114.

notes.author: ADJ-114
notes.note: site visit. Braided flexible connector between the shutoff valve and the upstairs toilet burst on 2026-03-14 while the insured was home. Insured shut the water off at the main within roughly 20 minutes. Water came through the ceiling of the dining room below. Contractor estimate for drywall, ceiling and flooring repair: $8,500. The connector itself was replaced by the insured for $40 and is not part of the claim. No prior leak history, no staining older than the event.

CLM-2026-10002.loss_type_reported: water damage - basement and ground floor

notes.author: FNOL-INTAKE
notes.note: First notice of loss: water damage - basement and ground floor, claimed $23,000. Assigned to ADJ-207.

notes.author: ADJ-207
notes.note: site visit. The Millbrook river crested on 2026-04-03 after three days of rain and overtopped its bank at the end of the insured's street. Water entered through the basement window wells and under the back door to a depth of about 18 inches on the ground floor. Neighbours on the same street report the same. Estimate for strip-out, drying and rebuild: $23,000. Insured asks whether the policy responds.

notes.author: FNOL-INTAKE
notes.note: First notice of loss: water damage - kitchen, claimed $14,200. Assigned to ADJ-309.

notes.author: ADJ-309
notes.note: site visit. Insured discovered buckled flooring in front of the kitchen sink on 2026-06-02. Plumber found the compression fitting on the cold supply line under the sink weeping, not burst. Tide-line staining on the cabinet base and the subfloor indicates water had been escaping for about three weeks before discovery. Insured was home throughout and did not notice. Estimate: $14,200 for cabinets, subfloor and flooring.

notes.author: FNOL-INTAKE
notes.note: First notice of loss: water damage - rental property, claimed $9,800. Assigned to ADJ-114.

notes.author: ADJ-114
notes.note: site visit. Tenant-occupied rental. The supply hose to the washing machine burst on 2026-02-20; the tenant says water covered the laundry room and kitchen within the hour before the landlord's handyman shut it off. The landlord had the plumbing inspected in January 2026 and has the invoice. Sudden event, no evidence of prior leakage. Estimate: $9,800.

notes.author: FNOL-INTAKE
notes.note: First notice of loss: loss assessment, claimed $3,000. Assigned to ADJ-207.

notes.author: ADJ-207
notes.note: file review. Windstorm on 2026-05-09 tore sections of the building's roof, which is collectively owned by the association. Windstorm is a peril insured against under SECTION I of the insured's unit-owners policy (confirmed from the declarations). The association's master policy excludes the roof covering as cosmetic, so the association levied a special assessment of $3,000 per unit to repair it. The assessment is not for the association's deductible and not for reserves. Insured submits the assessment letter.

notes.author: FNOL-INTAKE
notes.note: First notice of loss: loss assessment, claimed $2,500. Assigned to ADJ-309.

notes.author: ADJ-309
notes.note: file review. Windstorm damage to the building on 2026-01-18. The association's master policy paid the loss above its $50,000 windstorm deductible. To fund that deductible the board assessed each of the 20 units $2,500. Insured submits the assessment letter, which states the purpose as 'master policy deductible'.

notes.author: FNOL-INTAKE
notes.note: First notice of loss: water damage - basement, claimed $16,500. Assigned to ADJ-114.

notes.author: ADJ-114
notes.note: site visit. During heavy rain on 2026-04-11 the municipal sewer backed up through the basement floor drain; about 2 inches of standing water. No sewer backup buy-back endorsement on the file. By the date of inspection mould was visible on the lower 30 cm of drywall. Estimate: water mitigation and rebuild $9,800, mould remediation $6,700, total $16,500.

notes.author: FNOL-INTAKE
notes.note: First notice of loss: theft, claimed $6,000. Assigned to ADJ-207.

notes.author: ADJ-207
notes.note: call and police report. Burglary on 2026-05-27 while the insured was at work; rear door forced. Items taken: a diamond engagement ring appraised at $4,200 and a gold necklace appraised at $1,800, total $6,000. No other property taken or damaged. Appraisals from 2025 on file.

notes.author: FNOL-INTAKE
notes.note: First notice of loss: water damage - kitchen, claimed $11,000. Assigned to ADJ-309.

notes.author: FNOL-INTAKE
notes.note: First notice of loss: loss assessment, claimed $4,200. Assigned to ADJ-114.

notes.author: ADJ-114
notes.note: file review. The building's shared cold-water riser failed on 2026-03-02 and flooded the common hallways on three floors. Board minutes from 2024 and 2025 record the riser as corroded and the replacement deferred both years for budget reasons. The association assessed each unit owner $4,200 to repair the water damage to the common hallways.
